# API Reference Guide — ReturnIQ Enterprise

**Base URL:** `https://your-domain.com/api/v1`
**OpenAPI Spec:** `GET /openapi.json` (auto-generated by FastAPI)
**Interactive Docs:** `GET /docs` (Swagger UI, disable in production)
**Version:** 3.0.0

---

## Authentication

ReturnIQ uses two authentication methods:

### 1. JWT Bearer Token (Standard — for web users)

All standard API endpoints require a Bearer token in the `Authorization` header.

```
Authorization: Bearer <access_token>
```

**Getting a token:**
```http
POST /api/v1/auth/login
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "email": "user@example.com",
  "password": "YourPassword1"
}
```

Response:
```json
{
  "access_token": "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9...",
  "token_type": "bearer",
  "user": { "id": "...", "email": "...", "role": "org_admin" },
  "org": { "id": "...", "name": "Acme Returns" }
}
```

- Access tokens expire in **15 minutes**
- A `rl_refresh_token` httpOnly cookie is also set — use `POST /auth/refresh` to get
  a new access token silently
- After 5 failed login attempts, the account is locked for 15 minutes (HTTP 429)

### 2. API Key (External / ERP Integration)

For server-to-server integration, use the `X-API-Key` header. API keys are created
in the platform UI under Settings → API Keys.

```
X-API-Key: rlk_live_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
```

External API endpoints are prefixed with `/api/v1/ext/`.

---

## Rate Limits

| Endpoint Group | Limit | Window |
|---|---|---|
| `POST /auth/login` | 5 requests | 1 minute |
| `POST /auth/register` | 3 requests | 1 minute |
| All other endpoints | 100 requests | 1 minute |

Rate limit headers returned on every response:
```
X-RateLimit-Limit: 100
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 87
X-RateLimit-Reset: 1722470400
```

On exceeding the limit: `HTTP 429 Too Many Requests`

---

## Standard Error Format

All errors follow this structure:
```json
{
  "detail": "Human-readable error message"
}
```

| HTTP Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 400 | Bad Request — validation error, missing field |
| 401 | Unauthorized — missing or invalid token |
| 403 | Forbidden — valid token but insufficient role/permissions |
| 404 | Not Found — resource doesn't exist or belongs to another org |
| 409 | Conflict — duplicate resource (e.g. email already registered) |
| 422 | Unprocessable Entity — request body schema error |
| 429 | Too Many Requests — rate limit exceeded |
| 500 | Internal Server Error — see server logs; a request-id header is included |

---

## Endpoints

---

### Auth — `/api/v1/auth`

#### POST /auth/login
Login and receive access token.
**Body:** `{ "email": string, "password": string }`
**Returns:** `{ access_token, token_type, user, org }`
**Sets cookie:** `rl_refresh_token` (httpOnly)

#### POST /auth/register
Register a new organisation and admin user.
**Body:** `{ email, password, full_name, org_name }`
**Returns:** `{ access_token, token_type, user, org }`

#### POST /auth/refresh
Exchange refresh cookie for new access token.
**Requires:** `rl_refresh_token` cookie
**Returns:** `{ access_token, token_type }`

#### GET /auth/me
Get current user and org.
**Auth:** Bearer token
**Returns:** `{ user, org, api_keys }`

#### POST /auth/change-password
Change password for authenticated user.
**Body:** `{ current_password, new_password }`

#### POST /auth/logout
Revoke current session.
**Effect:** Deletes refresh token, clears cookie

---

### User Profile — `/api/v1/users`

#### GET /users/profile
Full profile with org context.

#### PATCH /users/profile
Update name or avatar_url.
**Body:** `{ full_name?: string, avatar_url?: string }`

#### POST /users/forgot-password
Request password reset.
**Body:** `{ email: string }`
**Note:** Always returns 200 regardless of whether email exists (prevents enumeration)

#### POST /users/reset-password
Consume reset token and set new password.
**Body:** `{ token: string, new_password: string }`

#### DELETE /users/account
Deactivate own account. Irreversible.

#### GET /users/sessions
Current session info.

#### DELETE /users/sessions
Revoke all other active sessions.

#### GET /users/activity
Last 100 audit log entries for this user.

---

### Returns — `/api/v1/returns`

#### POST /returns ⭐ Core Endpoint
Submit a return for AI scoring and routing.

**Body:**
```json
{
  "platform_order_id": "ORD-20250801-001",
  "customer_identifier": "customer@email.com",
  "sku": "ELECTRONICS-LAPTOP-001",
  "item_category": "Electronics",
  "item_value": 45000.00,
  "origin_pincode": "400001",
  "destination_pincode": "560001",
  "weight_grams": 2500,
  "volumetric_weight_grams": 3200,
  "return_reason_code": "defective",
  "courier": "BlueDart",
  "payment_mode": "Prepaid",
  "fragile": true,
  "festive": false,
  "condition": "damaged",
  "customer_notes": "Screen cracked on arrival"
}
```

**Response:**
```json
{
  "id": "uuid",
  "status": "prediction_done",
  "prediction": {
    "predicted_cost_inr": 1840.50,
    "risk_score": 23.5,
    "fraud_score": 12.0,
    "damage_probability": "high",
    "resale_value_estimate": 18000.00,
    "carbon_footprint_kg": 2.14,
    "confidence_score": 0.87,
    "routing_decision": "accept",
    "model_version": "xgb_v1",
    "inference_latency_ms": 28.4,
    "explainability": {
      "top_cost_driver": "item_value",
      "feature_importances": [...]
    }
  },
  "workflow_rules_applied": []
}
```

**Valid `return_reason_code` values:** `defective`, `wrong_item`, `not_as_described`,
`size_fit`, `changed_mind`, `damaged_in_transit`, `missing_parts`, `other`

**Valid `courier` values:** `BlueDart`, `Delhivery`, `Ekart`, `DTDC`, `XpressBees`, `Shadowfax`

#### GET /returns
List returns for this org with pagination.
**Query params:** `page`, `page_size`, `status`, `risk_min`, `routing_decision`

#### GET /returns/{return_id}
Single return with prediction.

#### PATCH /returns/{return_id}/status
Update return status.
**Body:** `{ status: string }`

#### PATCH /returns/{return_id}/outcome
Submit confirmed outcome (for ML training data collection).
**Body:** `{ actual_fraud_confirmed?: bool, actual_damage_grade?: string, actual_cost_inr?: number, notes?: string }`

#### GET /returns/dashboard
KPI summary: counts, totals, averages.

#### GET /returns/analytics
Breakdown by routing decision, category, fraud score distribution.

---

### Extended Returns — `/api/v1/returns/{id}/...`

#### POST /returns/{id}/notes
Add a timeline note.
**Body:** `{ note: string }`

#### GET /returns/{id}/notes
Get all timeline notes.

#### GET /returns/{id}/timeline
Full chronological timeline: events + notes + documents + SLA.

#### POST /returns/{id}/documents
Upload a document (multipart/form-data).
**Fields:** `file` (binary), `is_damage_photo` (bool)
**Limits:** 10MB, MIME types: image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp, application/pdf

#### GET /returns/{id}/documents
List documents for a return.

#### DELETE /returns/{id}/documents/{doc_id}
Delete a document.

#### DELETE /returns/{id}
Soft-delete a return. Requires `org_admin` role.

#### POST /returns/bulk
Import up to 50 returns at once. Partial-failure safe.
**Body:** `{ returns: [ReturnCreate, ...] }`

### AI Platform — `/api/v1/ai`

#### GET /ai/predictions/history
Paginated prediction history.
**Query:** `page`, `page_size`, `routing_decision`

#### GET /ai/predictions/{return_id}/explain
Full explainability for a prediction.

#### POST /ai/predictions/{return_id}/override
Manually override routing decision. Requires `analyst` role.
**Body:** `{ routing_decision: string, reason: string }`

#### POST /ai/feedback
Submit accuracy feedback.
**Body:** `{ prediction_id: string, was_accurate: bool, comments?: string }`

#### GET /ai/performance
Aggregate performance metrics and label collection progress.

---

### Customers — `/api/v1/customers`

#### GET /customers/
List with search, pagination, risk filter, blacklist filter.

#### POST /customers/
Create customer record.

#### GET /customers/{id}
Customer with return history summary.

#### PATCH /customers/{id}
Update customer fields.

#### DELETE /customers/{id}
Soft-delete. Requires `org_admin`.

#### POST /customers/{id}/blacklist
Blacklist a customer. Requires `org_admin`.
**Query:** `reason` (string)

#### GET /customers/{id}/analytics
Detailed analytics: return rate, fraud rate, reason breakdown.

#### GET /customers/export/csv
Stream CSV export of all customers.

---

### Notifications — `/api/v1/notifications`

#### GET /notifications/
List notifications. Query: `limit`, `unread_only`, `severity`.

#### GET /notifications/unread-count
`{ "unread_count": 3 }`

#### POST /notifications/mark-read
Mark specific notifications read.
**Body:** `{ notification_ids: [string, ...] }`

#### POST /notifications/mark-all-read
Mark all notifications read.

---

### Reports — `/api/v1/reports`

All report endpoints accept `date_from` (YYYY-MM-DD), `date_to`, and `format` (`json` or `csv`).

- `GET /reports/summary` — full returns summary
- `GET /reports/fraud` — high-risk returns ranked by fraud score
- `GET /reports/carbon` — carbon footprint by courier and category
- `GET /reports/customers` — customer analytics and fraud rates

---

### Workflows — `/api/v1/workflows`

#### GET /workflows/rules
List all rules for this org, ordered by priority.

#### POST /workflows/rules
Create a rule. Requires `org_admin`.

#### PATCH /workflows/rules/{id}
Update rule. Requires `org_admin`.

#### DELETE /workflows/rules/{id}
Delete rule. Requires `org_admin`.

#### GET /workflows/sla
List SLA records. Query: `breached_only=true`.

#### GET /workflows/sla/check-breaches
Scan for newly breached SLAs and mark them. Returns count.

---

### Organisation — `/api/v1/org`

#### POST /org/members/invite
Invite a member. Requires `org_admin`.
**Body:** `{ email, full_name, role }`

#### PATCH /org/members/{id}/role
Change role. Requires `org_admin`.

#### DELETE /org/members/{id}
Remove member. Requires `org_admin`.

#### PATCH /org/branding
Update logo, primary colour, website. Requires `org_admin`.

#### GET /org/feature-flags
List feature flags.

#### PUT /org/feature-flags/{name}
Toggle a feature flag. Requires `org_admin`.

---

### Admin — `/api/v1/admin` (super_admin only)

- `GET /admin/health` — system health and ML stats
- `GET /admin/orgs` — all organisations
- `GET /admin/users` — all users (passwords stripped)
- `PATCH /admin/users/{id}/status` — suspend / activate / delete user
- `GET /admin/system-settings` — system-wide settings
- `PUT /admin/system-settings/{key}` — set a system setting
- `GET /admin/audit-logs` — global audit log (up to 500 entries)
- `GET /admin/ml-stats` — ML model stats and label accumulation
- `GET /admin/db-statistics` — row counts for all major tables

---

### External API — `/api/v1/ext` (API Key auth)

- `POST /ext/returns` — submit a return (same schema as `/returns`)
- `GET /ext/returns` — list returns
- `GET /ext/returns/{id}` — get return with prediction
- `GET /ext/returns/dashboard` — KPI dashboard

## Webhook Events (Future — Phase 5.13 stub)

The `webhook_url` field in org settings is currently stored but not dispatched.
When implemented, events will include:
`return.created`, `return.prediction_done`, `return.status_changed`,
`fraud.flagged`, `sla.breached`

URL validation (rejecting private IP ranges and `169.254.169.254`) will be implemented
before dispatch is enabled. See `SECURITY_AUDIT_PHASE6.md` — OWASP A10 SSRF note.
